definition.title: 3D Printing One-on-One Appointment
definition.description:
Need help with 3D printing or looking for guided, hands-on experience? This session is idea for beginners seeking practical experience, guided support, and confidence in using 3D printing technology. This is also a good opportunity for those who attended our 3D Design & Printing workshop and now want to try their hands at it.

Participants will have the opportunity to print a simple model under supervision. If you do not have a design, you may choose a free design from Thingiverse or similar site. 

All designs are printed in a single color of PLA - filament color at the discretion of the program lead. Designs must print in 1 hour 45 minutes - if you're not sure how long your design will take to print, email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org.

SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print request.

All designs must be compatible with the Creality K1C printer and have a print time of under 45 minutes. Final approval of printability will be determined by the program lead.

One appointment per month per person. 

ADA Accommodation Requests

registrationInfo.instructions: Call us at (408) 808-3000 or stop by the Vineland Library to register.
registrationInfo.onlineInstructions:
Customers can book 1 session per month online.  Customers must have a design to print - free designs are available from websites like Thingiverse. If a customer has a custom design, the stl can be emailed to cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org or you can bring it on a flash drive.

This is an appointment for 3D printing assistance, not a print on demand service - customers should plan on being in the library for the duration of the appointment. At minimum, they must be present for setting up their desired print and must pick it up at the end of the appointment.

The print will be made using a single color of PLA filament. Filament color will be at library’s discretion.  SJPL reserves the right to refuse any print.

If you have more questions, please email cz.sjpl@sjlibrary.org
registrationInfo.instructionsToAttend: Registration reminder for 3D Printing One-on-One Appointment at the Calabazas Branch Library. Please be on time for your appointment and have your design ready.
